informal_statement: Let C and D be categories and F : C ≃ D an equivalence of categories. If a cospan (f : X → Z, g : Y → Z) admits a pullback (P, π₁, π₂) in C, then (F f, F g) admits a pullback (F P, F π₁, F π₂) in D.
proof_path: apply Equivalence.preservesLimitsOfShape to the pullback diagram
